When you take over an unfamiliar project folder from someone else and run a command, the tools configured inside may sit completely idle. In an untrusted folder, project MCP (a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) servers defined in `.mcp.json` are not loaded by default.

Now when you run `muse exec`, it directly tells you that these project servers were not loaded and how to load them. Running `muse mcp list` to inspect the list also explains why they were not loaded and how to load them.

⟦Picture opening a spreadsheet sent by a new acquaintance: previously clicking its macro buttons did nothing at all, whereas now a banner pops up at the top explaining why it was blocked and where to click to enable it.⟧

items.original: In an untrusted folder, `muse exec` now says that project MCP servers in `.mcp.json` were not loaded and how to load them, and `muse mcp list` says why and how to load them

title.zh-TW: 透過服務或開發套件開的旁支對話從空白開始
title.en: Side chats opened via the service or SDKs start empty

body.zh-TW:
在一段對話中途想另開旁支話題，以前常一打開就夾帶著整串前情提要。現在透過 `muse serve` 或 TypeScript、Python SDK（軟體開發套件）開啟的新旁支對話，會直接從空白開始，不再顯示原本那場對話的內容。

不過，在這次更新前就已經開好的旁支對話不受影響，依然會顯示原本的對話輪次；只要它還開著，工作階段清單也還是會把這些輪次算進去。

⟦討論到一半想另開小房間私聊，以前走進去牆上都掛著大廳剛才講過的話，現在裡面是一片乾淨的白板，更新前就開著的小房間則維持原樣。⟧
body.en:
When you want to branch off into a side topic mid-conversation, opening one used to bring along the entire preceding thread. New side chats opened through `muse serve` or the TypeScript and Python SDKs (developer toolkits) now start empty instead of showing the content of the original conversation.

However, side chats that were already open before this update are unaffected and still show the original conversation turns; as long as they remain open, the session list still counts those turns.

⟦When you step into a breakout room for a private chat mid-discussion, the walls used to be covered with everything just said in the main hall, but now there is a clean whiteboard inside, while rooms opened before the update stay as they were.⟧

items.original: A side chat opened through `muse serve` or the TypeScript and Python SDKs now starts empty instead of showing the turns of the conversation it came from (side chats opened before this update still show those turns and, while open, count them in the session list)

title.zh-TW: 新工作階段寫不進紀錄會先停下報錯
title.en: New sessions stop with an error if the log cannot be written

body.zh-TW:
剛開一個新工作階段送出第一句話，最怕模型已經開始跑，紀錄檔卻沒存下來。現在只要工作階段紀錄寫不進這第一筆模型請求，這一輪就會直接停住並回報可重試的儲存錯誤，不會呼叫模型。等到寫入成功，這筆請求就會存進紀錄。

⟦錄音室開錄新節目，以前錄音帶還沒開始轉就先讓來賓開講，現在確定錄音機寫得進去才開麥，寫不進去就先喊停讓你重試。⟧
body.en:
Right after starting a new session and sending your first message, the worst surprise is having the model start running while the log file fails to save. Now, if the session log cannot write this first model request, the turn stops immediately with a retryable storage error instead of calling the model. Once the write succeeds, the request is saved to the log.

⟦At a recording studio starting a new show, the guest used to begin speaking before the tape was even rolling, whereas now the mic only turns on once the recorder confirms it can write—if it cannot, the session pauses and lets you retry.⟧

items.original: If the session log can't save a new session's first model request, the turn now stops with a retryable storage error instead of calling the model; the request is saved once the write succeeds

title.zh-TW: 讀取與恢復長工作階段省資源又能取回紀錄
title.en: Reading and resuming long sessions saves resources and retrieves records

body.zh-TW:
在長工作階段裡讀檔與接續對話，過去常因為重複讀取和複製而多耗資源。

對串接介面的開發者來說，讀取或恢復長工作階段時，若只取中繼資料（描述工作階段的資訊，不含對話內容），現在需要的處理更少。若已存的歷史紀錄超過讀取上限，也不會只回傳超限結果，而是能取回待處理的請求與最後一輪對話。

從未壓縮過的工作階段，如果在恢復後緊接著再讀取一次，現在不會重頭讀完整份紀錄檔，只會讀取恢復那一步新增的內容。

恢復沒有儲存檢查點（紀錄進度的存檔點）的長工作階段時，啟動過程中佔用的記憶體也變少，因為起始紀錄不會再為每個讀取它的部分各複製一份。
body.en:
Reading files and continuing conversations in long sessions used to consume extra resources due to repeated reads and copying.

For developers integrating with the interface, reading or resuming a long session now requires less processing when requesting only metadata (information describing the session, without conversation content). If the saved history exceeds the read limit, instead of returning only an over-limit result, it can now retrieve pending requests and the last turn.

For a session that has never been compacted, reading it again right after resuming no longer reads the entire log file from the start; it only reads what the resume step added.

Resuming a long session without a saved checkpoint (a save point that records progress) also uses less memory during startup, because the starting records are no longer copied once for each part that reads them.

items.original:
A metadata-only `session/read` or `session/resume` (`excludeItems`) does less work on long sessions; a session whose saved history is over the read cap now gets its pending requests and last turn back instead of `noneReason: "projectionReadLimit"`
A `session/read` right after `session/resume` no longer reads the whole log again for a session that never compacted; it reads only what the resume added
Resuming a long session without a saved checkpoint uses less memory while it starts, because the records it starts from are no longer copied once for each part of the session that reads them

title.zh-TW: 修正重啟工作階段會漏掉最後一輪的問題
title.en: Fix restarting a session dropping the last turn

body.zh-TW: 最新那筆訊息剛好重複了前面已結束輪次的指示或規則。以前遇到這種情況，重啟工作階段會把這最後一輪直接漏掉。這個問題已經修好，現在重啟工作階段後仍會保留這一輪，不再把它丟掉。
body.en: When the most recent message happens to repeat the instructions or rules of an earlier, finished turn, restarting the session used to drop this final turn completely. This issue has been fixed, so restarting the session now preserves the turn instead of discarding it.

items.original: Restarting a session no longer drops its most recent turn when that turn repeats the instructions or rules of an earlier, finished turn

title.zh-TW: 修正取消工作流程誤報子任務被中止
title.en: Fix cancelling a workflow misreporting child tasks as killed

body.zh-TW: 執行到一半手動喊停後，清單上會列出這次一起停掉的背景作業。以前回報的結果裡，會把子任務自己的任務也當成該子任務被中止的背景任務報出來。這個問題已經修好，現在取消工作流程不再出現這筆誤報。
body.en: After manually stopping a run midway, the list shows the background jobs that were stopped along with it. Previously, the reported results mistakenly listed a child task's own task as one of that child's killed background tasks. This issue has been fixed, so cancelling a workflow no longer produces this false report.

items.original: Cancelling a workflow no longer reports a child's own task as one of that child's killed background tasks

title.zh-TW: 修正 Linux 沙盒指令留下空佔位資料夾
title.en: Fix Linux sandboxed commands leaving empty placeholder folders

body.zh-TW: 打開 Linux 上的專案目錄，偶爾會莫名出現一個空的佔位資料夾。這發生在沙盒（隔離執行的安全環境）指令遺失佔位紀錄的情況，過去即使共用它的指令跑完了，這個空資料夾還是會留著。這個問題已經修好，現在共用它的指令結束後不會再殘留空資料夾。
body.en: Opening a project directory on Linux would occasionally reveal an unexplained empty placeholder folder. This happened when a sandbox (an isolated, secure environment) command lost its placeholder bookkeeping, leaving the empty folder behind even after the command sharing it had finished. This issue has been fixed, so no empty placeholder folder remains once the command sharing it ends.

items.original: On Linux, a sandboxed command whose placeholder bookkeeping was lost no longer leaves an empty placeholder folder in your project once the command sharing it has finished

entries: The TypeScript SDK can cancel or time out `MuseClient.spawn` with a `signal` option, for example `AbortSignal.timeout(10_000)`; a host that never finishes starting is shut down instead of left running

The TypeScript SDK types `command` and `request` from the protocol schema, and a raw connection gains `addNotificationListener` for typed per-method notifications: results are typed, and a call whose params do not match a listed method's type is marked deprecated, ahead of becoming a compile error in a later release; so is a method name that mixes listed and unlisted names, or a generic one on a raw connection (widen it to `string` to keep sending it untyped)
`/resume` now marks sessions that need your input and updates them live

In the TypeScript and Python SDKs, `session.events({ subagents: true })` (Python: `session.events(subagents=True)`) also streams what each sub-agent does, step by step, tagged with the sub-agent it belongs to

Start Muse with `MUSE_SHELL_DROP_META_API_KEY=1` (or `true` or `yes`) to keep your `META_API_KEY` out of commands the agent runs, `!` commands and Monitor commands; a session on an already running Muse server follows that server's setting, and a Muse started by one of those commands gets no key from them
In the TypeScript SDK, `session.reload()` catches up a session the host unloaded while idle, keeping its state, handlers and pending turns instead of starting a new session

The `run.system_prompt_append` setting adds your text after the built-in system prompt instead of replacing it (up to 64 KiB). A session can also set its own value, and it keeps that value when it is resumed or forked

When your session language pin is English and Muse's visible output slips into another script, the harness now retries with a correction restating the pin (up to two corrective retries per response step, then the last attempt is delivered as-is) instead of re-issuing the identical request once

`prompt.surfaces` settings can now also turn off the five context statements that were always kept (workspace root, permission mode, sandbox policy, capability policy and code-mode profile); turning one off changes only what the model is told, never the sandbox, approvals or tool access it describes

When Muse deletes a session, at `session_retention_days` expiry or when it cleans up an empty session, it also removes the saved history that other Muse versions kept for that session, which used to stay on disk
A plugin reminder's instructions file can now be up to 32 KiB instead of 16 KiB; a larger file is still left out with a diagnostic

Muse keeps your session language pin across context compaction: a session that established or requested a language before compacting keeps it on later turns, instead of re-deriving it from the post-compaction messages alone

Prepares saved chats to store an "allow for this session" choice for commands that run on another machine: a version that reads these records refuses one with a field it does not know instead of reading a narrowed permission as a wider one; no chat contains them yet
The session index now caps its write-ahead log at 256 MiB by default, so the log stops growing past that size on always-on machines and listings stay unchanged
The away recap now appears when you come back to a session with just one message, and again after a background result adds new replies, instead of waiting for two more of your messages
The "Worked for" line now also appears after a turn started by a background result, such as a finished background agent, a scheduled task or a goal

On Windows, when a command fails because PowerShell has no Unix command such as `head`, `tail`, `grep` or `wc`, the result names the PowerShell command to use instead, so the agent fixes the command in one step

Chats from automated evaluation runs now keep a record of how each run was set up; earlier versions skip that record, and much older versions may refuse new prompts in such a chat after switching models; updating fixes it

On models other than Muse models, such as Claude, GPT and Gemini, Muse no longer adds an instruction naming the session language to the request or regenerates a reply whose visible text switches language or script; Muse models keep both
Security: A Git directory swapped for a symlink during a session is no longer writable through the link; shell commands run without it

Security: On Linux, the environment of a sandboxed command no longer appears on bubblewrap's command line in the unrestricted network mode, where any process on the machine could read it with `ps`; the command receives the same environment as before

Security: On Windows, where the drive supports file permissions, `auth.json` and `trust.json` are now created so only your account, SYSTEM and Administrators can open them, instead of inheriting the folder's permissions. Each Windows account needs its own config folder (set `XDG_CONFIG_HOME`); if another account can no longer open the file, delete the file and sign in again

After an automatic compaction, `contextUsage` now reports the compacted context instead of the run's summed tokens, so a session-protocol client's context meter drops as soon as the compaction installs
After you pause and resume a Workflow, a rerun agent's conversation now shows the same attempt number as its card (for example `attempt 2/2`) and lists the earlier attempt, instead of `attempt 1/1`
Cancelling a workflow no longer tells the model that an agent which had already finished has no result

Reopening a chat after it compacted no longer marks a finished subagent's kept worktree read-only with a startup warning when the compacted chat still mentions that subagent; it is handled as it would be without compaction
After the disk fills while a message to a subagent is being saved, the session keeps saving checkpoints once the disk frees, instead of skipping them until it is reopened
The agent replies before it starts a background workflow, instead of ending its turn with no answer
A reply that a Monitor event started now keeps its dim source label row when the reply streams in over several seconds, not only when it arrives all at once
Cancelling a whole Workflow now shows "Stopped with the workflow before this agent finished." for each agent that was still running, instead of an empty outcome with no reason
`muse serve` now answers a turn start or steer that takes more than 30 seconds to acknowledge with its real result, instead of an internal error while the turn still runs
In `muse serve`, the model list row for a `--model` choice that no catalog lists now names its provider's profile, like that provider's other rows
The context meter now follows the selected model's limit when switching between cloud models
A session created by a `muse serve` host now records which build created it, so `/export trajectory` for such a session carries `session_build`
After the disk fills while a message to a subagent is being saved, retrying that message no longer makes the session skip every later checkpoint
Reopening a session no longer leaves out a turn that reused the same rules or instructions as a turn from before a mid-session checkpoint
A turn with hundreds of tool calls no longer stops a session's saved view from updating, which left the view unavailable after the session was resumed
In a session log written by an older build, a tool call that had returned its result before a crash keeps that result in the session view instead of having it replaced by the crash notice

When a settings or trust file cannot be used — malformed JSON, a directory in its place, or an unsupported version — the error now ends with a `Recovery:` line naming the file and the next step, instead of leaving the start at a dead end
On Windows, stopping a terminal-mode (`tty`) PowerShell session run without the sandbox, after its shell already exited, now also ends the programs it left running
The resume picker no longer re-reads and re-derives every session row on each refresh when the sessions folder path is not valid UTF-8
On Windows, cancelling a `!` shell command now also stops the programs it started before it shows as cancelled
The TypeScript SDK now reports a `muse serve` exit even when a process it started still holds its output, instead of waiting forever

In the TypeScript and Python SDKs, `session.events()` no longer repeats an event after the SDK fills a gap in delivery (or, in TypeScript, after `session.reload()` replays it), and an event stream now ends when the client closes instead of waiting forever

`/compact` works again in a chat that was started with developer instructions and reopened by a terminal without a `run.developer_prompt` setting, instead of answering that no compactable run is available

The start refusal for an unreadable `settings.json` now names its recovery on the next line (make the file readable with `chmod u+r` or remove it, or move a regular file out of the config directory's place; an absent `settings.json` runs on defaults)
After you pause and resume a workflow, its elapsed time no longer jumps back or restarts at zero, and agents that finished before the pause keep counting and keep their model, tokens and time
Status, usage and MCP cards keep their right border in line when a row holds Arabic text with a lam-alef pair
A named Workflow agent keeps its name after it starts, so editors connected through `muse acp` no longer switch its line to the agent's id
Forking a session after a background monitor wake no longer carries the parent session's startup context into the new session beside its own
`/new` and `/clear` no longer exit to the shell when the previous session is still closing

On Linux, a sandboxed command started without `XDG_RUNTIME_DIR` now finds `/run/user/<uid>` and shares the placeholder registry with commands that use it, so another command of the same user cleaning up at exit no longer lifts its denied path
After the disk fills while a subagent message is settled, closing that subagent no longer makes the session skip every later checkpoint
Stopping a Workflow from the Tasks drawer or `/workflows` now tells the agent you stopped it and not to relaunch it, instead of saying the runtime cancelled it
On Linux, an empty placeholder folder no longer stays behind in your project when two overlapping sandboxed commands block the same missing path

On Linux, a sandboxed command whose `XDG_RUNTIME_DIR` is set but empty now shares the placeholder registry under `/run/user/<uid>` with the other commands of its user, so its exit cleanup no longer lifts a sibling command's denied path
On Linux, memory freed by a compaction or a resume returns to the system within a few seconds instead of about half a minute
Sessions take slightly less disk space: the skill reminder no longer saves a decision record when it finds nothing to suggest, so `muse exec --json` no longer prints that line
An idle session uses less CPU keeping its saved-session list current: each check reads a saved session's file details once instead of three times
A long session keeps less in memory for shell commands and Monitors that have finished
Session logs are a little smaller: a model call and a background reminder no longer write a `scheduled` record, so `muse exec --json` no longer prints that line for them

title.zh-TW: /resume 即時標示等你輸入的對話
title.en: /resume Marks Chats Waiting for Input Live

body.zh-TW:
想接續之前的進度，卻得一個個點開才知道哪個工作階段正停下來等你回覆。現在執行 `/resume` 開啟清單時，需要你輸入的工作階段會直接加上標記，狀態一有變動也會即時更新。

⟦打開通訊軟體時，以前得逐一點進聊天室才知道誰在等回覆，現在列表上直接亮出標記還會跟著即時刷新。⟧
body.en:
When picking up where you left off, you used to have to open each session one by one to see which one had paused for your reply. Now, when you run `/resume` to open the list, sessions that need your input are marked directly, and their status updates live whenever it changes.

⟦In a messaging app, you used to have to open each chat one by one to see who was waiting for a reply, whereas now the list lights up with a badge and refreshes live.⟧

items.original: `/resume` now marks sessions that need your input and updates them live

title.zh-TW: 提示詞附加與外掛指示上限調整
title.en: Prompt Appending and Plugin Instruction Limit Updates

body.zh-TW:
想在內建提示外補上自己的指令，或精簡模型看到的背景聲明，這版新增與放寬了幾項控制。

`run.system_prompt_append` 能把你的文字接在內建系統提示詞後面，上限 64 KiB，不會蓋掉原文。工作階段也能各自設定，恢復或分岔時會繼續保留。

`prompt.surfaces` 現在還能關掉工作區根目錄、權限模式、沙盒政策、能力政策與程式碼模式這五項固定聲明。關掉只改模型看到的文字，不會動到實際的沙盒（限制指令權限的隔離區）、核准流程或工具權限。

外掛提醒的指示檔上限從 16 KiB 提高到 32 KiB，超出時仍會略過並附上診斷。

⟦以前想改固定交代只能整頁重寫，現在就像在說明書末尾貼便利貼，也能直接劃掉不想讓對方唸出的欄位。⟧
body.en:
To add your own instructions alongside the built-in prompt or trim the background statements the model sees, this release adds and relaxes several controls.

`run.system_prompt_append` appends your text after the built-in system prompt, up to 64 KiB, without overwriting the original text. Sessions can also set their own values, which stay intact when resumed or forked.

`prompt.surfaces` can now also turn off five fixed statements: workspace root, permission mode, sandbox policy, capability policy, and code-mode profile. Turning them off changes only the text the model sees, without touching the actual sandbox (an isolated area that restricts command permissions), approval flow, or tool access.

The instructions file limit for plugin reminders increases from 16 KiB to 32 KiB, and larger files are still skipped with a diagnostic.

⟦Instead of rewriting an entire page just to tweak standard instructions, you can now stick a note at the end of the manual and cross out any fields you do not want read aloud.⟧

items.original:
The `run.system_prompt_append` setting adds your text after the built-in system prompt instead of replacing it (up to 64 KiB). A session can also set its own value, and it keeps that value when it is resumed or forked
`prompt.surfaces` settings can now also turn off the five context statements that were always kept (workspace root, permission mode, sandbox policy, capability policy and code-mode profile); turning one off changes only what the model is told, never the sandbox, approvals or tool access it describes
A plugin reminder's instructions file can now be up to 32 KiB instead of 16 KiB; a larger file is still left out with a diagnostic

title.zh-TW: 語言鎖定留給 Muse 模型並跨壓縮保留
title.en: Language Pinning Kept for Muse Models and Across Compaction

body.zh-TW:
用 Claude、GPT 或 Gemini 等非 Muse 模型對話時，現在不會再被強塞語言鎖定指令。切換成這些外部模型時，就算回覆文字換成別種語言或文字系統，Muse 也不再自動重新生成，只有 Muse 自家模型保留這兩項機制。

在 Muse 模型維持英文鎖定時，如果畫面輸出不小心溜出其他文字系統，以前只會拿同一份請求原封不動重問一次。現在改為附上重申鎖定的修正提示重試，每一步最多修正兩次，超過就把最後一次結果直接交給你。

設定或請求好工作階段語言後，就算中間經過上下文壓縮，Muse 也會把這份鎖定一路留到後續對話，不再只靠壓縮後的訊息重新猜測。

⟦出國請隨行翻譯記錄筆記，以前每換新頁他就得重新猜你想寫哪國字，現在交代過一次就一路記著，偶爾寫偏還會當場拉回來。⟧
body.en:
When chatting with non-Muse models such as Claude, GPT, or Gemini, language-pinning instructions are no longer forced into requests. When switching to these external models, even if a reply switches to another language or script, Muse no longer regenerates it automatically; only Muse's own models keep both behaviors.

When a Muse model has an English pin and visible output accidentally slips into another script, it used to simply resend the exact same request once. Now it retries with a corrective prompt restating the pin, up to two corrections per step, and delivers the final attempt as-is if it still slips.

Once a session language is set or requested, Muse keeps that pin through context compaction into later turns instead of guessing it again solely from the compacted messages.

⟦Think of an interpreter taking notes on a trip abroad: before, they had to guess which language you wanted on every new page, whereas now they remember your choice throughout and correct themselves on the spot if they slip.⟧

items.original:
When your session language pin is English and Muse's visible output slips into another script, the harness now retries with a correction restating the pin (up to two corrective retries per response step, then the last attempt is delivered as-is) instead of re-issuing the identical request once
Muse keeps your session language pin across context compaction: a session that established or requested a language before compacting keeps it on later turns, instead of re-deriving it from the post-compaction messages alone
On models other than Muse models, such as Claude, GPT and Gemini, Muse no longer adds an instruction naming the session language to the request or regenerates a reply whose visible text switches language or script; Muse models keep both

title.zh-TW: 啟動環境變數不讓金鑰流進殼層與監控
title.en: Startup Environment Variable Keeps Key Out of Shell and Monitor

body.zh-TW:
跑代理指令或背景監控時，有時不想讓自己的 `META_API_KEY` 順著執行環境一起被讀到。啟動 Muse 時設定環境變數（傳給程式讀取的背景設定值）`MUSE_SHELL_DROP_META_API_KEY=1`，或改設 `true`、`yes`，都能擋下這把金鑰。設定後，代理執行的指令、`!` 指令與 Monitor 指令都拿不到 `META_API_KEY`。

如果連上已經在跑的 Muse 伺服器，工作階段會直接沿用該伺服器的設定。由上述三類指令另外啟動的 Muse，也不會從它們身上拿到這把金鑰。

⟦好比借朋友門禁卡去地下室拿東西，以前得把整串含自家大門鑰匙的鑰匙圈都交出去，現在先把大門鑰匙拔下來再遞過去。⟧
body.en:
When running agent commands or background monitoring, you may not want your `META_API_KEY` read along with the execution environment. Starting Muse with the environment variable (a background setting passed to a program) `MUSE_SHELL_DROP_META_API_KEY=1`, or setting it to `true` or `yes`, blocks this key. Once set, commands run by the agent, `!` commands, and Monitor commands will not receive `META_API_KEY`.

If you connect to an already running Muse server, the session follows that server's setting directly. Any Muse instance started by one of those three command types will not receive the key from them either.

⟦When lending a friend a keycard to grab something from the basement, you used to have to hand over your whole keyring with your front-door key on it, whereas now you take the front-door key off first.⟧

items.original: Start Muse with `MUSE_SHELL_DROP_META_API_KEY=1` (or `true` or `yes`) to keep your `META_API_KEY` out of commands the agent runs, `!` commands and Monitor commands; a session on an already running Muse server follows that server's setting, and a Muse started by one of those commands gets no key from them

title.zh-TW: Windows 登入與信任檔限制其他帳號存取
title.en: Windows Sign-In and Trust Files Restrict Other Accounts

body.zh-TW:
多人共用同一台電腦，過去設定資料夾的權限會直接沿用下去，讓同機的別人也有機會打開。只要磁碟支援檔案權限，現在新建的 `auth.json` 與 `trust.json` 只會允許你的帳號、`SYSTEM` 和 `Administrators` 開啟。

每個 Windows 帳號必須改用自己的設定資料夾，請設定 `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` 來分開存放。如果其他帳號因此再也打不開原本的檔案，直接刪除該檔並重新登入即可。

⟦就像把存摺和印章從客廳抽屜移進只認自己指紋的小保險箱，其他家人不能再順手打開，但也得各自準備專屬抽屜。⟧
body.en:
When multiple people share the same computer, config folder permissions used to be inherited directly, giving others on the same machine a chance to open them. Where the drive supports file permissions, newly created `auth.json` and `trust.json` files now allow only your account, `SYSTEM`, and `Administrators` to open them.

Each Windows account must use its own config folder by setting `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` to store files separately. If another account can no longer open the original file as a result, simply delete that file and sign in again.

⟦Moving your bankbook and seal from a living room drawer into a small safe that only recognizes your fingerprint keeps other family members from casually opening them, though everyone now needs their own drawer.⟧

items.original: Security: On Windows, where the drive supports file permissions, `auth.json` and `trust.json` are now created so only your account, SYSTEM and Administrators can open them, instead of inheriting the folder's permissions. Each Windows account needs its own config folder (set `XDG_CONFIG_HOME`); if another account can no longer open the file, delete the file and sign in again

title.zh-TW: 修補 Git 符號連結與 Linux 沙盒漏洞
title.en: Fixes for Git Symlink and Linux Sandbox Vulnerabilities

body.zh-TW:
執行殼層與沙盒指令時，現在不能透過被替換的 Git 目錄連結寫入。Linux 沙盒在不限網路模式下，也不再把環境變數暴露在 bubblewrap 的指令列上。

工作階段進行中若把 Git 目錄換成 symlink（符號連結，指向另一個位置的捷徑檔），現在無法透過這個連結寫入，殼層指令會在排除該連結的情況下執行。

在 Linux 開啟不限網路模式的沙盒執行指令時，環境變數以前會直接暴露在 bubblewrap 的指令列上，同機其他程式用 `ps` 就能讀到。現在指令列不再顯示這些變數，指令本身照舊拿到相同環境。

⟦就像以前把門牌換成假箭頭就能進屋、把密碼貼在信封外頭讓人偷看，現在這兩條漏洞都被封死，只有裡面的人能照常收信。⟧
body.en:
When running shell and sandboxed commands, writing through a swapped Git directory link is no longer allowed. In unrestricted network mode, the Linux sandbox also no longer exposes environment variables on bubblewrap's command line.

If a Git directory is swapped for a symlink (a shortcut file pointing to another location) during a session, writing through that link is now blocked, and shell commands run without it.

When running sandboxed commands on Linux in unrestricted network mode, environment variables used to appear directly on bubblewrap's command line, where other processes on the same machine could read them with `ps`. Now the command line no longer shows those variables, while the command itself still receives the same environment.

⟦Before, swapping a door sign for a fake arrow let someone walk right in, and taping a password to the outside of an envelope let others peek; now both holes are sealed so only those inside receive mail as usual.⟧

items.original:
Security: A Git directory swapped for a symlink during a session is no longer writable through the link; shell commands run without it
Security: On Linux, the environment of a sandboxed command no longer appears on bubblewrap's command line in the unrestricted network mode, where any process on the machine could read it with `ps`; the command receives the same environment as before

title.zh-TW: Linux 沙盒多指令並行與路徑清理修復
title.en: Fixes for Concurrent Linux Sandbox Commands and Path Cleanup

body.zh-TW:
同一個 Linux 使用者並排執行多個沙盒指令，封鎖路徑與暫存目錄現在會各自守好邊界。

啟動沙盒指令若沒設定 `XDG_RUNTIME_DIR`，或該變數為空字串，都會去找 `/run/user/<uid>` 共用同一份佔位登錄表。這樣同使用者的其他指令在結束清理時，就不會誤把別條指令封鎖的路徑一起放行。

當兩個重疊的沙盒指令同時擋下同一個不存在的路徑時，退場後也不會在你的專案裡留下空的佔位資料夾。

以前多指令重疊或缺少環境變數時容易誤解封鎖或遺留空資料夾，這些情況現在都已修好。
body.en:
When the same Linux user runs multiple sandboxed commands side by side, denied paths and temporary directories now stay within their own boundaries.

If a sandboxed command starts without `XDG_RUNTIME_DIR` set, or with it set to an empty string, it falls back to `/run/user/<uid>` and shares the same placeholder registry. That way, other commands from the same user cleaning up at exit will not accidentally lift a path denied by another command.

When two overlapping sandboxed commands block the same missing path at the same time, they no longer leave an empty placeholder folder behind in your project after exiting.

Issues where overlapping commands or missing environment variables could accidentally lift blocks or leave empty folders behind are now fixed.

items.original:
On Linux, a sandboxed command started without `XDG_RUNTIME_DIR` now finds `/run/user/<uid>` and shares the placeholder registry with commands that use it, so another command of the same user cleaning up at exit no longer lifts its denied path
On Linux, an empty placeholder folder no longer stays behind in your project when two overlapping sandboxed commands block the same missing path
On Linux, a sandboxed command whose `XDG_RUNTIME_DIR` is set but empty now shares the placeholder registry under `/run/user/<uid>` with the other commands of its user, so its exit cleanup no longer lifts a sibling command's denied path

title.zh-TW: 離開回顧與背景任務提示更快出現
title.en: Away Recap and Background Task Prompts Appear Sooner

body.zh-TW:
把對話擱著去忙別的事，或讓背景任務自己跑完後，過去常得再補傳兩句才看得到進度回顧。

現在只要工作階段裡至少有一則訊息，你回來就會看到離開回顧；背景結果添上新回覆後還會再出現一次，不必再多等自己傳兩則訊息。

由背景代理、排程任務或目標結果啟動的回合結束後，也會顯示「Worked for」耗時行。

若回覆是由 Monitor 事件觸發，就算串流幾秒才輸出完畢，淡色的來源標記列也會留著，不再只有一次整段送達時才顯示。

⟦想像請幫手在廚房燉湯，以前你得連問兩次他才報進度，現在回頭看一眼或他端出新菜，桌邊就會放好進度卡。⟧
body.en:
After stepping away from a chat or letting a background task finish on its own, you used to have to send two more messages before seeing a progress recap.

Now the away recap appears as soon as you return to a session with at least one message, and again after a background result adds new replies, without waiting for two more messages from you.

Turns started by a background agent, scheduled task, or goal result now also display the "Worked for" elapsed-time line when they finish.

When a reply is triggered by a Monitor event, its dim source label row now stays visible even when the reply streams in over several seconds, instead of appearing only when it arrives all at once.

⟦Picture asking a helper to simmer soup in the kitchen: before, you had to ask twice to get a status update, whereas now a progress card sits by the table as soon as you glance back or they bring out a new dish.⟧

items.original:
The away recap now appears when you come back to a session with just one message, and again after a background result adds new replies, instead of waiting for two more of your messages
The "Worked for" line now also appears after a turn started by a background result, such as a finished background agent, a scheduled task or a goal
A reply that a Monitor event started now keeps its dim source label row when the reply streams in over several seconds, not only when it arrives all at once

title.zh-TW: 對話壓縮功能與容量計顯示修復
title.en: Fixes for Chat Compaction and Context Meter Display

body.zh-TW:
長對話執行壓縮或換用不同雲端模型，過去常碰到容量計數字不降或壓縮指令失靈。

自動壓縮生效後，工作階段協定的用戶端介面上，容量計現在會立刻降到壓縮後的實際用量，不再一直拿整輪累計的 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）來算。在雲端模型之間切換時，容量計的上限也會跟著改用新模型的額度。

帶著開發者指示開始的對話，用沒有設定 `run.developer_prompt` 的終端機重開後，現在可以正常執行 `/compact`，不會再回報找不到可壓縮的執行紀錄。

壓縮後的對話若仍提到已結束的子代理人，重開後不會再把它的 worktree（工作樹，Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）標為唯讀並跳出警告。現在它會比照未壓縮的對話正常接手。

⟦行李箱把冬衣抽真空壓扁後，以前指針秤還停在壓縮前的舊數字，現在秤面馬上掉回實際重量，換新箱子也會跟著換刻度。⟧
body.en:
When compacting long chats or switching between cloud models, the context meter used to stay stuck or the compaction command would fail.

After automatic compaction takes effect, the context meter in session-protocol client interfaces now drops immediately to the compacted actual usage instead of continuing to count the summed tokens (the text units AI processes and bills by) from the whole run. When switching between cloud models, the context meter's limit also updates to use the new model's quota.

Chats started with developer instructions and reopened in a terminal without `run.developer_prompt` set can now run `/compact` normally instead of reporting that no compactable run is available.

If a compacted chat still mentions a finished subagent, reopening it no longer marks that subagent's worktree (a Git feature for opening multiple parallel copies of the same project) as read-only with a warning. It is now handled normally just like an uncompacted chat.

⟦After vacuum-sealing winter coats in a suitcase, the dial scale used to stay stuck on the old pre-compression number, whereas now the needle drops to the actual weight right away and switches markings when you change suitcases.⟧

items.original:
After an automatic compaction, `contextUsage` now reports the compacted context instead of the run's summed tokens, so a session-protocol client's context meter drops as soon as the compaction installs
Reopening a chat after it compacted no longer marks a finished subagent's kept worktree read-only with a startup warning when the compacted chat still mentions that subagent; it is handled as it would be without compaction
The context meter now follows the selected model's limit when switching between cloud models
`/compact` works again in a chat that was started with developer instructions and reopened by a terminal without a `run.developer_prompt` setting, instead of answering that no compactable run is available

title.zh-TW: Workflow 啟動回覆、計時與名稱修正
title.en: Fixes for Workflow Startup Replies, Timing, and Names

body.zh-TW:
啟動或暫停重啟 Workflow，代理人的開場回覆、累計時間和卡片編號過去常對不上。

代理人現在會在啟動背景 Workflow 前先給你一個回覆，不再直接結束回合而留下空白。

暫停並恢復 Workflow 後，經過時間不再倒退或歸零，暫停前已結束的代理人也會繼續累計時間並保留模型與 token 紀錄。重新執行的代理人對話會像卡片一樣標示 `attempt 2/2` 這類正確的嘗試次數並列出前一輪，不再錯寫成 `attempt 1/1`。

透過 `muse acp` 連線的編輯器上，具名的 Workflow 代理人啟動後會留住原本名稱，不會被換成代理人的編號。

以前暫停重啟或用編輯器檢視進度常看到錯亂的數字與代號，這些問題現在都已修好。
body.en:
When starting or pausing and resuming a Workflow, an agent's opening reply, elapsed time, and card attempt numbers used to mismatch.

The agent now sends you a reply before starting a background Workflow, instead of ending its turn blank.

After pausing and resuming a Workflow, elapsed time no longer jumps back or resets to zero, and agents that finished before the pause continue counting time and keep their model and token records. A rerun agent's conversation now displays the correct attempt count matching its card, such as `attempt 2/2`, and lists the earlier round instead of wrongly showing `attempt 1/1`.

In editors connected through `muse acp`, a named Workflow agent keeps its original name after starting instead of being replaced with the agent's ID.

Issues where pausing and resuming or viewing progress in an editor showed mismatched numbers and IDs are now fixed.

items.original:
After you pause and resume a Workflow, a rerun agent's conversation now shows the same attempt number as its card (for example `attempt 2/2`) and lists the earlier attempt, instead of `attempt 1/1`
The agent replies before it starts a background workflow, instead of ending its turn with no answer
After you pause and resume a workflow, its elapsed time no longer jumps back or restarts at zero, and agents that finished before the pause keep counting and keep their model, tokens and time
A named Workflow agent keeps its name after it starts, so editors connected through `muse acp` no longer switch its line to the agent's id

title.zh-TW: 中止 Workflow 時的狀態與不重啟通知
title.en: Workflow Stop Status and No-Relaunch Notice

body.zh-TW:
手動中止整個 Workflow 後，畫面上與送給模型的結束通知過去常少寫關鍵原因。

現在取消進行中的 Workflow 時，對於取消前早就跑完的代理人，不會再誤向模型回報它沒有結果。當時還在跑的代理人，結果會顯示「Stopped with the workflow before this agent finished.」，不再留白。

如果從 Tasks 抽屜或輸入 `/workflows` 停掉 Workflow，程式會明確告訴代理人是你主動喊停且不要再重新啟動，不再寫成被執行環境取消。

不再把已完成的代理人回報成沒有結果，也會明確告知代理人是你主動停止、不要重新啟動。
body.en:
Manually stopping an entire Workflow used to leave key reasons missing from both the screen and the completion notice sent to the model.

Now, cancelling an active Workflow no longer mistakenly tells the model that an agent that had already finished has no result. Any agent still running at the time shows "Stopped with the workflow before this agent finished." instead of a blank outcome.

If you stop a Workflow from the Tasks drawer or by running `/workflows`, it now tells the agent you stopped it and not to relaunch, rather than saying the runtime cancelled it.

Finished agents are no longer reported as having no result, and agents are clearly told you stopped them and not to relaunch.

items.original:
Cancelling a workflow no longer tells the model that an agent which had already finished has no result
Cancelling a whole Workflow now shows "Stopped with the workflow before this agent finished." for each agent that was still running, instead of an empty outcome with no reason
Stopping a Workflow from the Tasks drawer or `/workflows` now tells the agent you stopped it and not to relaunch it, instead of saying the runtime cancelled it

title.zh-TW: TypeScript SDK 連線控制與型別升級
title.en: TypeScript SDK Connection Control and Type Upgrades

body.zh-TW:
給串接 TypeScript SDK 的開發者，這版強化了連線啟動、型別檢查與工作階段接續。

啟動連線支援取消或逾時控制，主機久未完成啟動會直接關閉，不再留在背景空轉。閒置時被主機卸載的工作階段能原地重載，保留狀態、處理函式與待處理對話，不必重開。

指令、請求與原始連線通知監聽已依協定結構加上型別。參數不符已列管方法的型別，或方法名稱混用已列管與未列管名稱，會先標記過時。原始連線上的泛型方法名稱也會如此；這些情況之後將改為編譯錯誤，想不帶型別傳送須放寬為字串型別。

當 `muse serve` 結束時，就算它啟動的程式還佔著輸出串流，SDK 也會回報結束，不再卡等。

⟦跟寄快遞一樣，以前無人收件只能原地乾等，現在逾時就能撤單，斷線也能憑原本單號原地接續。⟧
body.en:
For developers integrating the TypeScript SDK, this release strengthens connection startup, type checking, and session resumption.

Starting a connection now supports cancellation or timeouts, shutting down a host that takes too long to start instead of leaving it idling in the background. A session unloaded by the host while idle can reload in place, keeping its state, handlers, and pending turns without starting over.

Commands, requests, and raw-connection notification listeners are now typed from the protocol schema. Calls whose parameters do not match a listed method's type, or method names that mix listed and unlisted names, are marked deprecated first. The same applies to generic method names on a raw connection; these will become compile errors later, so widen the name to `string` to keep sending untyped.

When `muse serve` exits, the SDK reports the exit even if a process it started still holds the output stream, instead of waiting forever.

⟦Just like sending a courier package, if nobody answered before you could only wait around, whereas now you can cancel on timeout and resume with the same tracking number if disconnected.⟧

items.original:
The TypeScript SDK can cancel or time out `MuseClient.spawn` with a `signal` option, for example `AbortSignal.timeout(10_000)`; a host that never finishes starting is shut down instead of left running
The TypeScript SDK types `command` and `request` from the protocol schema, and a raw connection gains `addNotificationListener` for typed per-method notifications: results are typed, and a call whose params do not match a listed method's type is marked deprecated, ahead of becoming a compile error in a later release; so is a method name that mixes listed and unlisted names, or a generic one on a raw connection (widen it to `string` to keep sending it untyped)
In the TypeScript SDK, `session.reload()` catches up a session the host unloaded while idle, keeping its state, handlers and pending turns instead of starting a new session
The TypeScript SDK now reports a `muse serve` exit even when a process it started still holds its output, instead of waiting forever

title.zh-TW: SDK 事件串流支援子代理人並修正重複
title.en: Subagent Support and Duplicate Fixes in SDK Event Streams

body.zh-TW:
在 TypeScript 與 Python SDK 追蹤代理進度，過去看不到子代理人的個別動作，重連也容易重複收到訊息或卡住。這版更新針對串接這兩種 SDK 的開發者擴充了事件串流功能。

訂閱工作階段事件時現在能開啟子代理人追蹤，串流會逐步送出每個子代理人的動作，並標明這筆事件屬於哪一個子代理人。

補齊遺漏事件或在 TypeScript 端重新載入並重播後，串流不會再重複吐出同一筆事件；用戶端關閉時，事件串流也會跟著結束，不再無限等待。

⟦看多人協作的現場轉播時，以前分不清哪位助手在做什麼、重連還重播舊畫面，現在每個人動作都標清且不重複。⟧
body.en:
Tracking agent progress in the TypeScript and Python SDKs previously hid individual subagent actions and could repeat messages or hang on reconnect. This release expands event streaming for developers integrating either SDK.

When subscribing to session events, you can now enable subagent tracking so the stream delivers each subagent's actions step by step, tagged with the subagent each event belongs to.

After filling in missed events, or after reloading and replaying in TypeScript, the stream no longer emits the same event twice; when the client closes, the event stream ends with it instead of waiting forever.

⟦Watching a live broadcast of a team at work used to leave you guessing which helper did what and replaying old footage on reconnect, whereas now everyone's actions are clearly labeled without repeats.⟧

items.original:
In the TypeScript and Python SDKs, `session.events({ subagents: true })` (Python: `session.events(subagents=True)`) also streams what each sub-agent does, step by step, tagged with the sub-agent it belongs to
In the TypeScript and Python SDKs, `session.events()` no longer repeats an event after the SDK fills a gap in delivery (or, in TypeScript, after `session.reload()` replays it), and an event stream now ends when the client closes instead of waiting forever

title.zh-TW: muse serve 逾時與清單紀錄修正
title.en: muse serve Timeout and Listing Fixes

body.zh-TW:
用 `muse serve` 在背景託管對話服務，遇到久候指令或自訂模型過去容易碰到誤報錯誤或資料缺漏。

當開啟回合或調整方向的請求花超過 30 秒才回應時，只要回合還在執行中，`muse serve` 現在會等著傳回真正的處理結果，不再直接丟出內部錯誤。

在命令列傳入目錄未收錄的 `--model` 名稱時，模型清單裡那一行現在會像同提供者的其他項目一樣，清楚標出所屬提供者的設定檔名稱。

由 `muse serve` 主機建立的工作階段現在也會記下建立時的建置版本，之後執行 `/export trajectory` 匯出紀錄時就能帶有這份版本資訊。

⟦打電話交代遠端櫃檯辦長任務時，以前對方超過期限沒回話就先掛斷報錯，現在願意等到辦完並把結果報回來。⟧
body.en:
Hosting conversation services in the background with `muse serve` previously risked false errors or missing data on slow commands or custom models.

When a request to start or steer a turn takes over 30 seconds to respond, `muse serve` now waits to return the real result as long as the turn is still running, instead of throwing an internal error.

When passing a `--model` name on the command line that is not listed in a catalog, its row in the model list now clearly shows its provider's profile name, just like other entries from that provider.

Sessions created by a `muse serve` host now record the build that created them, so running `/export trajectory` later includes that build info.

⟦Calling a remote counter with a long task used to mean they hung up with an error once a deadline passed without a reply, whereas now they wait until the job is done and report back.⟧

items.original:
`muse serve` now answers a turn start or steer that takes more than 30 seconds to acknowledge with its real result, instead of an internal error while the turn still runs
In `muse serve`, the model list row for a `--model` choice that no catalog lists now names its provider's profile, like that provider's other rows
A session created by a `muse serve` host now records which build created it, so `/export trajectory` for such a session carries `session_build`

title.zh-TW: 設定與信任檔無法讀取改附修復指引
title.en: Recovery Guidance for Unreadable Settings and Trust Files

body.zh-TW:
想打開 Muse 卻被擋在門外，只因為裡頭的 JSON 寫壞、版本不合或權限不夠，過去畫面只會留下一條死胡同。

現在遇到這類錯誤時，錯誤訊息末尾會多出一行 `Recovery:`，點名出問題的檔案與下一步做法；這涵蓋 JSON 格式錯誤、設定位置被資料夾佔用，或不支援的檔案版本。

若是 `settings.json` 權限不足導致無法啟動，下一行會列出解方：用 `chmod u+r` 補上權限、刪除該檔，或把佔住設定目錄的檔案移走。如果原本就沒有 `settings.json`，Muse 會直接套用預設值啟動。

⟦以前車子發不動，儀表板只亮一個紅燈讓你自己猜；現在直接亮出哪顆零件鬆了、拿幾號扳手去轉，照著做就能發動。⟧
body.en:
Getting locked out of Muse because of broken JSON, an unsupported version, or insufficient permissions used to leave you at a dead end.

Now, when such an error occurs, the message ends with a `Recovery:` line naming the file and the next step; this covers malformed JSON, a directory occupying the config path, or an unsupported file version.

If unreadable permissions on `settings.json` prevent startup, the next line lists the fix: add permissions with `chmod u+r`, delete the file, or move the file blocking the config directory. If `settings.json` does not exist at all, Muse starts with defaults.

⟦Previously, when a car wouldn't start, the dashboard only lit a red warning light and left you guessing; now it shows which part is loose and which wrench to grab so you can follow along and get running.⟧

items.original:
When a settings or trust file cannot be used — malformed JSON, a directory in its place, or an unsupported version — the error now ends with a `Recovery:` line naming the file and the next step, instead of leaving the start at a dead end
The start refusal for an unreadable `settings.json` now names its recovery on the next line (make the file readable with `chmod u+r` or remove it, or move a regular file out of the config directory's place; an absent `settings.json` runs on defaults)

title.zh-TW: 磁碟寫滿清出空間後恢復儲存檢查點
title.en: Checkpoint Saving Resumes After Freeing Full Disk

body.zh-TW:
硬碟空間在儲存或結算子代理人訊息時塞滿，過去可能讓後續檢查點存檔一路停擺。

如果在保存要給子代理人的訊息時磁碟剛好寫滿，只要清出空間，工作階段之後就會繼續正常儲存檢查點，不必等到重開工作階段才恢復。

就算之後重試那則先前寫入失敗的訊息，或在訊息結算時遇上磁碟已滿後再關閉該子代理人，工作階段都不會再跳過後續所有的檢查點。

儲存或結算子代理人訊息時遇上磁碟寫滿，現在清出空間就能接續存檔，後續重試訊息或關閉子代理人也不會讓檢查點停存。
body.en:
Running out of disk space while saving or settling a subagent message used to stall all subsequent checkpoint saves.

If the disk fills up while saving a message for a subagent, the session now resumes saving checkpoints normally once space is freed, without needing to reopen the session.

Even if you later retry that failed message, or close the subagent after hitting a full disk during message settlement, the session no longer skips all later checkpoints.

When the disk fills while saving or settling a subagent message, freeing space now lets saving continue, and retrying the message or closing the subagent no longer halts checkpoints.

items.original:
After the disk fills while a message to a subagent is being saved, the session keeps saving checkpoints once the disk frees, instead of skipping them until it is reopened
After the disk fills while a message to a subagent is being saved, retrying that message no longer makes the session skip every later checkpoint
After the disk fills while a subagent message is settled, closing that subagent no longer makes the session skip every later checkpoint

title.zh-TW: 工作階段重開、分岔與切換對話修復
title.en: Fixes for Session Reopening, Forking, and Switching

body.zh-TW:
聊到一半想另起新線、清掉重來，或把舊紀錄叫回來接續，過去常遇到少了一回合、畫面卡死或直接退回終端機。

重開工作階段時，如果某個回合重複使用了中途檢查點之前的規則或指示，該回合現在不會再被漏掉。即使單一回合呼叫做過上百次工具，工作階段的存檔檢視也會照常更新，不再造成重開後無法查看。

若是讀取舊版建置寫下的工作階段紀錄，崩潰前已經回傳結果的工具呼叫在檢視畫面裡會保留原本結果，不再被換成崩潰通知。

被背景監控喚醒後再分岔出新工作階段時，新對話只會帶入自己的啟動背景，不會把父工作階段的啟動背景也一併帶進來。執行 `/new` 或 `/clear` 切換對話時，就算上一個工作階段還沒關完，也不會再直接跳出回到殼層。

以前切換或重開對話常碰上缺頁或閃退，現在對話紀錄與切換過程都能完整接續。
body.en:
Starting a new thread mid-chat, clearing to start over, or pulling up an old log to continue used to drop a turn, freeze the view, or kick you back to the terminal.

When reopening a session, a turn that reused rules or instructions from before a mid-session checkpoint is no longer left out. Even if a single turn makes hundreds of tool calls, the session's saved view still updates normally instead of becoming unavailable after reopening.

When reading a session log written by an older build, a tool call that had already returned its result before a crash keeps that result in the view instead of being replaced by a crash notice.

When forking a new session after a background monitor wake, the new chat only carries its own startup context and no longer pulls in the parent session's startup context as well. Running `/new` or `/clear` to switch chats no longer exits to the shell even if the previous session is still closing.

Where switching or reopening chats used to hit missing pages or sudden exits, both chat history and switching now continue smoothly.

items.original:
Reopening a session no longer leaves out a turn that reused the same rules or instructions as a turn from before a mid-session checkpoint
A turn with hundreds of tool calls no longer stops a session's saved view from updating, which left the view unavailable after the session was resumed
In a session log written by an older build, a tool call that had returned its result before a crash keeps that result in the session view instead of having it replaced by the crash notice
Forking a session after a background monitor wake no longer carries the parent session's startup context into the new session beside its own
`/new` and `/clear` no longer exit to the shell when the previous session is still closing

title.zh-TW: 跨版本對話紀錄的權限與評估格式相容
title.en: Cross-Version Chat Log Permission and Evaluation Compatibility

body.zh-TW:
不同版本的 Muse 讀取同一份對話存檔，不能因為欄位變動就把權限看寬或擋掉新問題。

這版先替跨機執行指令的「此工作階段允許」選項做好儲存格式準備，目前還沒有任何對話寫入這欄。往後若由不認得新欄位的版本讀取這類紀錄，程式會直接拒讀，避免把原本縮小的權限誤判成更寬的授權。

自動化評估執行產生的對話現在會記錄每次執行的設定方式。較早的版本會略過這份紀錄，而更舊的版本在切換模型後可能會拒絕接受新提示，只要更新 Muse 就能解決。

⟦像新版表格多了一欄限制條件，如果舊印表機認不得那一欄就乾脆拒印，免得把「限本人簽收」印成「誰都能領」。⟧
body.en:
When different versions of Muse read the same saved chat, field changes must not widen permissions or prevent new prompts from being accepted.

This release prepares the storage format for an "allow for this session" choice on commands that run on another machine, though no chats write this field yet. Going forward, if a version that does not recognize the new field reads such a record, it refuses to load it rather than misreading a narrowed permission as a wider grant.

Chats generated by automated evaluation runs now record how each run was set up. Earlier versions skip this record, while much older versions may refuse new prompts after switching models, which updating Muse resolves.

⟦Imagine a new form adding a restriction column: if an old printer doesn't recognize that column, it simply refuses to print rather than turning "recipient signature required" into "anyone can pick up."⟧

items.original:
Prepares saved chats to store an "allow for this session" choice for commands that run on another machine: a version that reads these records refuses one with a field it does not know instead of reading a narrowed permission as a wider one; no chat contains them yet
Chats from automated evaluation runs now keep a record of how each run was set up; earlier versions skip that record, and much older versions may refuse new prompts in such a chat after switching models; updating fixes it

title.zh-TW: 工作階段刪除清理與紀錄檔瘦身
title.en: Session Deletion Cleanup and Log Trimming

body.zh-TW:
一直開著 Muse 跑任務或反覆執行指令，磁碟裡累積的舊版紀錄與冗餘日誌容易越堆越大。

刪除工作階段、達到 `session_retention_days` 到期或清理空工作階段，Muse 現在會把其他版本留下的同份歷史一併清掉，不再留在磁碟上。

工作階段索引的預寫日誌（寫入索引前先記下變更的紀錄檔）預設上限設為 256 MiB，讓常開機的機器不會越長越大，清單顯示照舊。

技能提醒若沒有任何建議要給，就不再寫入判斷紀錄；模型呼叫與背景提醒也不再寫入排程紀錄。這讓工作階段更省空間，執行 `muse exec --json` 時也不會再印出這兩類多餘輸出。

過去常駐執行容易在硬碟留下舊版殘留與空白紀錄，現在容量與輸出都會精簡許多。
body.en:
Keeping Muse open for tasks or running commands repeatedly used to pile up old-version history and redundant logs on disk.

When deleting a session, reaching `session_retention_days` expiry, or cleaning up an empty session, Muse now removes the saved history for that session left by other versions as well, instead of leaving it on disk.

The session index's write-ahead log (a record of changes saved before updating the index) now defaults to a 256 MiB cap so it stops growing on always-on machines, while listings stay unchanged.

Skill reminders no longer save a decision record when they have nothing to suggest, and model calls and background reminders no longer write scheduled records. This saves space for sessions and stops `muse exec --json` from printing those two extra lines.

Where long-running use used to leave old remnants and empty records on disk, both storage and output are now much leaner.

items.original:
When Muse deletes a session, at `session_retention_days` expiry or when it cleans up an empty session, it also removes the saved history that other Muse versions kept for that session, which used to stay on disk
The session index now caps its write-ahead log at 256 MiB by default, so the log stops growing past that size on always-on machines and listings stay unchanged
Sessions take slightly less disk space: the skill reminder no longer saves a decision record when it finds nothing to suggest, so `muse exec --json` no longer prints that line
Session logs are a little smaller: a model call and a background reminder no longer write a `scheduled` record, so `muse exec --json` no longer prints that line for them

title.zh-TW: 降低閒置、長對話與重開時的資源消耗
title.en: Lower Resource Use When Idle, Long-Running, or Reopening

body.zh-TW:
掛著對話不動、跑長任務或刷新清單，過去常常默默耗掉多餘的 CPU 與記憶體。

在 Linux 上，壓縮或恢復工作階段所釋放出的記憶體，現在幾秒內就會還給系統，不再得等大約半分鐘。跑得比較久的工作階段，對於已經結束的殼層指令與 Monitor，也會減少記憶體佔用。

工作階段閒置時為了更新已存對話清單，每次檢查現在只會讀取檔案細節一次而不是三次，能降低 CPU 負擔。當工作階段資料夾路徑不是合法的 UTF-8（一種常見的文字編碼格式）時，恢復選擇器每次刷新也不會再重頭重讀並重算每一列。

以前掛著不動或處理舊紀錄常白耗電腦效能，現在能減少 CPU 與記憶體占用，並更快把釋放的記憶體還給系統。
body.en:
Leaving a chat idle, running long tasks, or refreshing lists used to quietly burn extra CPU and memory.

On Linux, memory freed by compacting or resuming a session now returns to the system within a few seconds instead of about half a minute. Longer-running sessions also keep less in memory for finished shell commands and Monitors.

When a session is idle and updating its saved-chat list, each check now reads file details once instead of three times, cutting CPU overhead. When the sessions folder path is not valid UTF-8 (a common text encoding format), the resume picker no longer re-reads and re-derives every row from scratch on each refresh.

Where sitting idle or handling old logs used to waste system resources, CPU and memory usage are now lower and freed memory returns to the system faster.

items.original:
The resume picker no longer re-reads and re-derives every session row on each refresh when the sessions folder path is not valid UTF-8
On Linux, memory freed by a compaction or a resume returns to the system within a few seconds instead of about half a minute
An idle session uses less CPU keeping its saved-session list current: each check reads a saved session's file details once instead of three times
A long session keeps less in memory for shell commands and Monitors that have finished

title.zh-TW: Windows 缺 Unix 指令改直接給替代名
title.en: Missing Unix Commands on Windows Now Return PowerShell Alternatives

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 上讓代理跑命令列工作，PowerShell 本身沒有 `head`、`tail`、`grep` 或 `wc` 這類 Unix 指令，一叫就出錯。現在遇到這類失敗，回傳結果會直接點名該改用哪一個 PowerShell 指令，讓代理一步就能改對重跑。
body.en: When you run command-line tasks through an agent on Windows, PowerShell lacks Unix commands like `head`, `tail`, `grep`, or `wc`, so calling them fails immediately. Now, when this kind of failure happens, the returned result directly names which PowerShell command to use instead, letting the agent fix the command and rerun it in one step.

items.original: On Windows, when a command fails because PowerShell has no Unix command such as `head`, `tail`, `grep` or `wc`, the result names the PowerShell command to use instead, so the agent fixes the command in one step

title.zh-TW: Windows 特定殼層操作補上殘留程式清理
title.en: Leftover Process Cleanup Added for Specific Windows Shell Operations

body.zh-TW:
在 Windows 操作 `!` 指令或沒開沙盒的終端機模式工作階段，過去按下停止後常還有背景程式在背後繼續跑。

現在在 Windows 取消 `!` 殼層指令時，顯示已取消前就會先把該指令啟動的程式一併關掉。若是結束沒有沙盒的終端機模式 tty 的 PowerShell 工作階段，就算裡面的殼層早就退出了，它原本留下的程式現在也會跟著一起結束。

⟦以前關掉廚房總開關，抽油煙機卻還在後面空轉；現在按下停止鈕，它牽出來的所有小馬達都會一起斷電停住。⟧
body.en:
When running `!` commands or unsandboxed terminal-mode sessions on Windows, background programs often kept running after you hit stop.

Now, when cancelling a `!` shell command on Windows, the programs it started are shut down before it shows as cancelled. When stopping an unsandboxed terminal-mode tty PowerShell session, any programs it left behind now exit along with it, even if the shell inside had already exited.

⟦Shutting off the kitchen's main breaker used to leave the range hood spinning in the background; now, pressing the stop button cuts power to every small motor wired to it and stops them together.⟧

items.original:
On Windows, stopping a terminal-mode (`tty`) PowerShell session run without the sandbox, after its shell already exited, now also ends the programs it left running
On Windows, cancelling a `!` shell command now also stops the programs it started before it shows as cancelled

title.zh-TW: 修正阿拉伯文導致卡片右框線錯位
title.en: Fixed Right Border Misalignment Caused by Arabic Text on Cards

body.zh-TW: 你可能會打開狀態、用量或 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）資訊欄。只要裡頭出現帶 lam-alef 連字的字句，右側邊界過去就會跟著歪斜。這個排版問題已經修好，現在遇到這類阿拉伯文時，右框線都能整齊對成一條直線。
body.en: You might open the status, usage, or MCP (a protocol for connecting AI to external tools) info cards. Whenever a line inside contained a phrase with a lam-alef ligature, the right border used to shift out of line. That layout issue is now fixed, so the right border stays neatly aligned in a straight line when displaying this kind of Arabic text.

items.original: Status, usage and MCP cards keep their right border in line when a row holds Arabic text with a lam-alef pair

entries: A chat started with `/fork` no longer sends the model the original chat's startup context, such as its skills list and session id, beside its own after a reply in the original chat wrote a message before using a tool

title.zh-TW: `/fork` 新對話不再夾帶舊的啟動資訊
title.en: New `/fork` chats no longer carry old startup context

body.zh-TW:
聊到一半想試別的點子，可以打 `/fork`（把對話分岔出去、從這刻另開一條線）接續討論。

過去在原對話裡，只要有回覆先寫了文字再使用工具，之後分岔出來的新對話就會多送出一份資料。它會把原對話的技能清單、工作階段 ID 等啟動背景資訊，跟新對話自己的那份並排送給模型。現在這個行為已經修正，分岔後不再夾帶原對話的啟動背景資訊。⟦就像開新分店時，以前連總店的舊門牌和營業清單都會一起並排掛在門口，現在只掛新分店自己的那一組。⟧
body.en:
When you want to try a different idea mid-conversation, you can type `/fork` (branching the conversation off into a separate thread from that point) to continue the discussion.

Previously, if a reply in the original chat wrote text before using a tool, any new chat forked afterward would send an extra copy of data. It would send the original chat's startup context, such as its skills list and session ID, side by side with the new chat's own context to the model. This behavior is now fixed, so forked chats no longer carry the original chat's startup context. ⟦Picture opening a new branch: previously, the main store's old plaque and business list were hung side by side at the door too, and now only the new branch's own set goes up.⟧

items.original: A chat started with `/fork` no longer sends the model the original chat's startup context, such as its skills list and session id, beside its own after a reply in the original chat wrote a message before using a tool

entries: Claude models can read images: attached images, images a tool reads, and images in a resumed session now reach the model instead of failing the turn

The TypeScript and Python SDK clients can now hear every notification, rejected messages, and the connection closing through `onNotification`/`on_notification`, `onProtocolError`/`on_protocol_error`, and `closed`
Over the session protocol, a session can now stop a background command that a subagent at any depth below it started, not only one its direct subagents started
A `session/start` sent to `muse serve` can now mark the new session as a `/clear` with the optional `clear` field, so its `SessionStart` hooks get the `clear` source

A `goal/pause` or `goal/clear` sent over `muse serve` while the goal's turn is running now reaches that turn, so the model stops working for the paused or cleared goal instead of carrying on until the turn ends

On Linux, a sandboxed shell command keeps a deny inside a missing protected folder such as `.git` even when another sandboxed command in the same workspace cannot see its sandbox records, for example because the two use different runtime directories
At start, a key in `tui.keymap` for an action that your build does not have no longer resets your other custom keys. The build ignores only that key and shows one notice that names it
Asking the `search` tool for files by name now lists the matching files instead of returning nothing

In `muse exec`, a persistent Monitor started after the run has answered is refused with a reason instead of starting and being stopped again, and the stop notice for a persistent watch at the end of the run now says why it stopped
Report environment errors when the bundled Linux sandbox cannot start a command
A session that has started many subagents uses less memory, because fewer copies of each subagent start record are kept in memory
Long sessions with many tool steps use less memory, because watching a task or a run for new records no longer sets aside room for a thousand records in advance
Long sessions use less memory after a compaction, because the subagent view no longer keeps every earlier event

title.zh-TW: Claude 模型現在能直接讀取圖片
title.en: Claude models can now read images directly

body.zh-TW: 貼上報表截圖想請 Claude 幫忙核對數字，過去一送出就整回合失敗。現在 Claude 模型能正常收到這幾類來源的圖片，包含你直接附加的圖片、工具讀取到的圖片，以及接續舊工作階段時裡頭既有的圖片，不會再中斷這回合。⟦跟拿現場照片去問修繕師傅一樣，以前他一看到圖就整單退回，現在不管是你帶來、助手找出來，還是舊紀錄裡夾著的照片，都能照常看圖處理。⟧
body.en: Pasting a screenshot of a report to ask Claude to check the numbers used to fail the entire turn as soon as you sent it. Now Claude models properly receive images from these sources, including images you attach directly, images a tool reads, and existing images inside a resumed session, without interrupting the turn. ⟦Picture bringing an on-site photo to ask a repair technician for help: before, he would reject the whole job as soon as he saw a picture, whereas now he can look at the photo and handle it as usual whether you brought it, an assistant found it, or it was tucked inside an old record.⟧

items.original: Claude models can read images: attached images, images a tool reads, and images in a resumed session now reach the model instead of failing the turn

title.zh-TW: SDK 用戶端現在能接收通知與斷線事件
title.en: SDK clients can now receive notifications and disconnect events

body.zh-TW: 給串接 TypeScript 與 Python SDK（供外部程式呼叫這套工具的開發介面）的開發者，寫程式時常要追蹤工具端傳來的訊息與連線狀態。現在用戶端能收到每一則通知、被拒收的訊息，以及連線關閉的事件。
body.en: For developers integrating the TypeScript and Python SDK (the developer interface for external programs to call this tool), writing code often means tracking messages and connection status from the tool. Now clients can receive every notification, rejected messages, and connection closing events.

items.original: The TypeScript and Python SDK clients can now hear every notification, rejected messages, and the connection closing through `onNotification`/`on_notification`, `onProtocolError`/`on_protocol_error`, and `closed`

title.zh-TW: 工作階段協定與 muse serve 控管更到位
title.en: More complete session protocol and muse serve control

body.zh-TW:
拿外部程式串接後端控管任務，過去會碰上深層背景指令停不掉，或中途叫停卻得等整個回合跑完。

透過工作階段協定，上層工作階段現在能停掉底下任何層級子代理（主任務派出去分頭工作的分身）啟動的背景指令，不再只限直屬的那一層。

傳送開啟請求給 `muse serve` 時，現在可以附帶標記把新工作階段當成 `/clear` 重置，讓 `SessionStart` hook（特定事件發生時會觸發的小程式）收到清除來源通知。

某個目標的回合還在跑時，經由 `muse serve` 送出的暫停或清除指令現在會直接傳進該回合。模型隨即會停下該目標的工作，不再繼續執行到回合結束。
body.en:
When connecting an external program to the backend to control tasks, deep background commands used to be impossible to stop, or pausing midway still required waiting for the whole turn to finish.

Through the session protocol, a parent session can now stop background commands started by a subagent (an assistant spawned by the main task to work separately) at any depth below it, no longer limited to the direct level.

When sending a start request to `muse serve`, you can now attach a flag to treat the new session as a `/clear` reset so that `SessionStart` hooks (small programs triggered when specific events happen) receive the clear source notice.

When a goal's turn is still running, a pause or clear command sent through `muse serve` now goes straight into that turn. The model then stops working on that goal instead of continuing until the turn ends.

items.original:
Over the session protocol, a session can now stop a background command that a subagent at any depth below it started, not only one its direct subagents started
A `session/start` sent to `muse serve` can now mark the new session as a `/clear` with the optional `clear` field, so its `SessionStart` hooks get the `clear` source
A `goal/pause` or `goal/clear` sent over `muse serve` while the goal's turn is running now reaches that turn, so the model stops working for the paused or cleared goal instead of carrying on until the turn ends

title.zh-TW: Linux 沙盒守住尚未建立的受保護資料夾
title.en: Linux sandbox keeps rules for uncreated protected folders

body.zh-TW: 在 Linux 上開沙盒（限制指令亂動檔案的隔離環境）執行指令，就算 `.git` 這類受保護位置還沒建出來，裡面的拒絕規則照樣會留著。即使同工作區另一道沙盒指令看不到前者的沙盒紀錄，例如兩者使用不同的執行期目錄，也一樣。⟦就像社區空地上還沒蓋起機房，值班警衛仍會保留預定地的禁入規定；即使另一位警衛看不到這位值班警衛的巡邏本，規定依然有效。⟧
body.en: When running commands in a Linux sandbox (an isolated environment that keeps commands from altering files freely), deny rules inside a protected location such as `.git` still remain even if that folder has not been created yet. This holds even when another sandboxed command in the same workspace cannot see the first one's sandbox records, for example because the two use different runtime directories. ⟦Think of an empty lot in a neighborhood where a utility room has not been built yet: the guard on duty still keeps the no-entry rule for the reserved site, and even if another guard cannot see that guard's patrol log, the rule still holds.⟧

items.original: On Linux, a sandboxed shell command keeps a deny inside a missing protected folder such as `.git` even when another sandboxed command in the same workspace cannot see its sandbox records, for example because the two use different runtime directories

title.zh-TW: tui.keymap 單鍵無效不再重置其他快捷鍵
title.en: Invalid single key in tui.keymap no longer resets other shortcuts

body.zh-TW: 從跨版本複製過來的快捷鍵設定裡，只要混進一個目前版本沒有的動作，以前一啟動就會把整份自訂按鍵洗回預設。現在啟動時若 `tui.keymap` 裡有對應不到動作的按鍵，程式只會略過那一顆按鍵，並跳出一則寫明該按鍵名稱的通知，其餘自訂按鍵都會保留。⟦好比遙控器裡多存了一個這台電視沒有的功能鈕，以前整支遙控器的個人設定會跟著歸零，現在只把那顆鈕放著不管，並亮牌提醒是哪一顆。⟧
body.en: When keybinding settings copied across versions include an action that the current build does not have, starting up used to wipe the entire custom key configuration back to defaults. Now, if `tui.keymap` has a key that maps to no action at startup, the app skips only that key and pops up a notice naming it, while keeping all other custom keys. ⟦Imagine a remote control with an extra button saved for a feature this TV does not have: before, all personal settings on the remote would reset to zero, whereas now that single button is left alone and a sign lights up to show which one it is.⟧

items.original: At start, a key in `tui.keymap` for an action that your build does not have no longer resets your other custom keys. The build ignores only that key and shows one notice that names it

title.zh-TW: 修正 search 工具依檔名查不到檔案
title.en: Fix search tool not finding files by name

body.zh-TW: 要找特定檔名的檔案而呼叫 `search` 工具時，過去總是拿不到任何結果、只看到空白回應。這個問題已經修好，現在依檔名尋找檔案會正常列出符合的清單。
body.en: When calling the `search` tool to find files with a specific name, it used to return no results and show only an empty response. That issue is now fixed, and searching for files by name properly lists the matching files.

items.original: Asking the `search` tool for files by name now lists the matching files instead of returning nothing

title.zh-TW: muse exec 持續監看被拒或停止會寫明原因
title.en: muse exec now states the reason when a persistent watch is refused or stopped

body.zh-TW: 執行 `muse exec` 已經給出回答後，若還要開啟持續性的 Monitor（常駐監看程序），過去會先啟動一次再被立刻停掉。現在這種情況會直接拒絕啟動並附上原因，不再先啟動再被停掉。而原本在執行結束時收掉的持續監看，現在的停止通知也會寫明停止的原因。⟦餐廳打烊收桌後還想加點，以前服務生會先收單再馬上退回來，現在當場婉拒並講明原因，原本收攤時的停單通知也會寫清楚為何停止。⟧
body.en: After `muse exec` has already given an answer, trying to open a persistent Monitor (a background watching process) used to start it once and immediately stop it. Now that attempt is refused directly with a reason instead of starting and stopping again. And for a persistent watch closed when a run ends, the stop notice now also states why it stopped. ⟦A diner tries to add an order after the restaurant has closed and cleared the tables: before, the server would take the ticket and immediately send it back, whereas now the request is politely refused on the spot with an explanation, and the closing notice at the end of service also states clearly why orders stopped.⟧

items.original: In `muse exec`, a persistent Monitor started after the run has answered is refused with a reason instead of starting and being stopped again, and the stop notice for a persistent watch at the end of the run now says why it stopped

title.zh-TW: Linux 內建沙盒無法啟動指令會回報環境錯誤
title.en: Bundled Linux sandbox reports environment errors when unable to start commands

body.zh-TW: 在 Linux 上準備執行指令，結果連第一步都跑不起來，這時候最需要明確的提示。碰到內建沙盒無法啟動指令的情況，現在會直接回報環境錯誤。
body.en: When preparing to run a command on Linux and even the first step fails to start, a clear prompt is what you need most. When the bundled sandbox cannot start a command, it now directly reports an environment error.

items.original: Report environment errors when the bundled Linux sandbox cannot start a command

title.zh-TW: 長工作階段與多子代理執行更省記憶體
title.en: Long sessions and multi-subagent runs use less memory

body.zh-TW:
在同一個對話開過許多子代理，記憶體裡不再保留那麼多份各個子代理的啟動紀錄複本。

包含許多工具步驟的長工作階段也會減少記憶體用量，因為監看任務或執行過程的新紀錄時，不再預先留好一千筆紀錄的空間。

經歷對話壓縮（把較早的聊天內容濃縮整理以騰出空間）後的長工作階段同樣更省記憶體，因為子代理檢視畫面不再把早先的每一筆事件都留著。
body.en:
When many subagents have been opened in the same conversation, memory no longer keeps as many copies of each subagent's start record.

Long sessions with many tool steps also use less memory, because watching a task or a run for new records no longer reserves room for a thousand records in advance.

Long sessions after conversation compaction (condensing earlier chat messages to free up space) also use less memory, because the subagent view no longer keeps every earlier event.

items.original:
A session that has started many subagents uses less memory, because fewer copies of each subagent start record are kept in memory
Long sessions with many tool steps use less memory, because watching a task or a run for new records no longer sets aside room for a thousand records in advance
Long sessions use less memory after a compaction, because the subagent view no longer keeps every earlier event

entries: Sessions take less disk space: the goal reminder no longer saves a separate log file for each check. To keep those logs, set `plugins.goal-reminder.child_session_log` to `"retained"` in `settings.json`

Sessions take less disk space: the verify reminder no longer saves a separate log file for each check. To keep those logs, set `plugins.verify-reminder.child_session_log` to `"retained"` in `settings.json`
Reading an image file or getting an image from an MCP tool no longer breaks the session on a model that cannot view images; the result says the image was not attached
Agent sessions in editors warn when the session can no longer be saved
`muse exec --json --image` now labels each attached image `[Image #N]` in the prompt, as `muse exec --image` without `--json` already does

Answers in French, Spanish, German, and other non-English languages are no longer discarded and rewritten when your first message is short; Muse sets English as the session language only when your messages use common English words or you ask for English
A session that has compacted no longer re-reads its whole session log in the background after a compaction

title.zh-TW: 目標與驗證提醒預設不再單獨存下檢查紀錄
title.en: Goal and verify reminders no longer save separate check logs by default

items.original:
Sessions take less disk space: the goal reminder no longer saves a separate log file for each check. To keep those logs, set `plugins.goal-reminder.child_session_log` to `"retained"` in `settings.json`
Sessions take less disk space: the verify reminder no longer saves a separate log file for each check. To keep those logs, set `plugins.verify-reminder.child_session_log` to `"retained"` in `settings.json`

title.zh-TW: 不支援看圖的模型讀到圖片不再中斷
title.en: Models that cannot view images no longer break when reading images

body.zh-TW:
手邊用的是不能辨識圖片的模型，以前碰到圖片會讓整個工作階段直接中斷。現在不論讀取圖片檔，或從 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）工具取得圖片，工作階段都不會再中斷，結果裡只會註明圖片沒有附上。

⟦跟只收純文字的舊款呼叫器一樣，以前收到照片會整台當機，現在只會顯示圖片沒附上，連線不會中斷。⟧
body.en:
If you are using a model that cannot recognize images, encountering an image used to break the entire session. Now, whether you read an image file or get an image from an MCP (a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) tool, the session no longer breaks, and the result simply notes that the image was not attached.

⟦Like an old text-only pager that used to crash completely when receiving a photo, it now just shows that the image was not attached without dropping the connection.⟧

items.original: Reading an image file or getting an image from an MCP tool no longer breaks the session on a model that cannot view images; the result says the image was not attached

title.zh-TW: 編輯器內的代理工作階段無法存檔會跳警告
title.en: Agent sessions in editors warn when they can no longer be saved

body.zh-TW: 你跟 AI 互動到一半，如果這段紀錄沒辦法繼續存下來，以前不會收到任何提示。現在只要工作階段無法再存檔，編輯器就會發出警告。
body.en: If you were in the middle of interacting with AI and the session could no longer be saved, you used to receive no notice. Now, whenever the session can no longer be saved, the editor shows a warning.

items.original: Agent sessions in editors warn when the session can no longer be saved

title.zh-TW: muse exec 的 JSON 附圖也會加編號
title.en: muse exec with JSON also numbers attached images

body.zh-TW: 過去執行 `muse exec --json --image` 帶入圖片，提示詞裡不會幫圖片加上編號。現在它會比照不加 `--json` 的 `muse exec --image`，在提示裡為每張附圖標上 `[Image #N]`。
body.en: Previously, running `muse exec --json --image` to include images did not number them in the prompt. Now, matching `muse exec --image` without `--json`, it labels each attached image `[Image #N]` in the prompt.

items.original: `muse exec --json --image` now labels each attached image `[Image #N]` in the prompt, as `muse exec --image` without `--json` already does

title.zh-TW: 短句開頭的非英文回答不再被丟棄重寫
title.en: Non-English answers after a short opening message are no longer discarded and rewritten

body.zh-TW:
第一則訊息只打幾個字，原本會讓法文、西班牙文、德文等外語回覆整個作廢重來。現在這些非英文回答都會留住。Muse 只會在你的訊息使用常見英文單字，或你主動要求用英文時，才會把工作階段語言設成英文。

⟦好比手機自動切換輸入法，以前開頭打太短就會把剛寫好的外語整段刪掉換成英文，現在除非出現常見英文詞或你主動要求，否則不會擅自換語言。⟧
body.en:
Typing just a few words in your first message used to cause replies in French, Spanish, German, and other non-English languages to be discarded and rewritten. Now those non-English answers are kept. Muse only sets the session language to English when your messages use common English words or when you ask for English.

⟦Picture a phone that auto-switches keyboards: previously, a short opening message would wipe out the foreign-language text you just wrote and replace it with English, whereas now it will not switch languages on its own unless common English words appear or you ask for it.⟧

items.original: Answers in French, Spanish, German, and other non-English languages are no longer discarded and rewritten when your first message is short; Muse sets English as the session language only when your messages use common English words or you ask for English

title.zh-TW: 壓縮完的工作階段不再回頭重讀全部紀錄
title.en: Compacted sessions no longer re-read their entire log

body.zh-TW: 工作階段剛做完壓縮，以前還會在背景把整份工作階段紀錄從頭再讀過。現在壓縮結束後，這項背景重讀已經取消。
body.en: Right after a session compacted, it used to re-read the entire session log from the beginning in the background. Now, once compaction finishes, that background re-read has been canceled.

items.original: A session that has compacted no longer re-reads its whole session log in the background after a compaction

entries: The session protocol gains an experimental `subagent/workStop` request that stops a session's subagents the way the terminal UI's own stop does, so the agent is told the user stopped them

Session-protocol clients get a `subagentResult` item each time a session consumes a subagent's result, at that point in the session, with the result's status (`completed`, `failed` or `cancelled`) when the view saw it, so a client can show each finished subagent where its parent read the result
TypeScript SDK: `FoldExtension` hooks observe custom notifications in the session fold and host-wide events
In the TypeScript and Python SDKs, `session.events()` streams what each incoming event changed in a session, so a client can update its view incrementally

The TypeScript and Python SDKs add `MuseClient.request` for queries the client does not wrap, and `command` and `request` send experimental methods when the client is spawned with `experimentalApi: true`

A `subagent` item's `result` in the session protocol now carries `superseded: true` once the subagent started a newer attempt after that result, so a client can take the subagent's status from its control state

Muse asks you right away, before the other steps, when a network policy refuses a download a step needs, instead of probing other sources or naming the block only in its final report, builds and tests on the up-to-date branch when your checkout is behind and its build fails, keeps working until a fix the failure output names is applied or offered, and makes browser app forms return their result from your own click instead of waiting on a background step

A Muse build older than this release cannot open a chat that a newer build connected, or tried to connect, to another machine to run commands there. When such a chat is resumed by id or chosen in the session picker, that build may instead start a new local chat on its own that reads the old chat's log and continues the work on this machine; update the app before reopening the chat, because that work may have been written for the other machine. Other chats are unaffected
Browser games follow the stack the request names instead of always using plain HTML files
When a turn does not fit the model's context window, the message now says you can start a new session

Session-protocol clients: view cursors are now minted in the `v10:` spelling; a cursor in an older spelling is refused once with the standard "reopen without a cursor" guidance, and a view cache saved by an older build is rebuilt on first use, so no client silently skips or misreads events
Shell commands sandboxed on macOS can look up the current user name, so ssh works as it does outside the sandbox
Session listings now run in two phases by default, so a long listing no longer holds the session log open while it runs; listings are unchanged, and logs that are already very large do not shrink yet
